scenario.topic: Pick a graphics card upgrade for the shared rendering workstation

options.name: NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti 12GB
options.upside: Balances power efficiency with strong ray tracing and AI rendering support.

shared_context: The team needs to upgrade the shared rendering workstation's graphics card to improve 3D rendering performance and support current software requirements. The card must be compatible with the existing PCIe 4.0 slot and fit within a 280mm case length limit.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a 3D artist focused on detailed environments and texture-heavy scenes.
personas.private_goal: Maximize VRAM to handle complex scenes without lag or crashes.

A.reason_for: Good power efficiency and ray tracing support.
A.reason_against: VRAM of 12GB might be limiting for very complex scenes.

B.reason_for: Largest VRAM (20GB) ideal for complex scenes and textures.

C.reason_against: Only 10GB VRAM and length close to case limit; less ideal for large scenes.

D.reason_for: Strong 16GB VRAM and good rendering performance.
D.reason_against: Older architecture may miss newer optimizations.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a software engineer optimizing rendering pipelines and hardware compatibility.
personas.private_goal: Ensure stable, well-supported hardware that integrates smoothly with existing software.

A.reason_for: Good balance of power and modern architecture with PCIe 4.0 compatibility.

B.reason_against: Higher power and cooling demands complicate integration.

C.reason_for: Mature drivers and broad software support ensure stability.

D.reason_against: Older architecture may lack some optimizations.

personas.name: Zoe
personas.background: Zoe is a technical artist focused on leveraging AI and ray tracing in workflows.
personas.private_goal: Prioritize cutting-edge features like AI rendering and ray tracing efficiency.

A.reason_for: Strong ray tracing and AI rendering support with efficient power use.

B.reason_against: Higher power consumption and cooling needs.

D.reason_against: Older RDNA 2 architecture lacks latest features.

personas.name: Eli
personas.background: Eli is a systems administrator managing hardware upgrades and maintenance.
personas.private_goal: Choose a stable, compatible card that fits case and power constraints with minimal hassle.

A.reason_for: Fits case size and PCIe 4.0, with reasonable power draw.
A.reason_against: Power supply upgrade might be needed.

B.reason_for: Fits size and PCIe 4.0, with ample VRAM.
B.reason_against: Higher power consumption may stress cooling.

D.reason_for: Fits case and PCIe 4.0 slot, with strong VRAM and manageable power.
